Putting preliminary notes here for the parking-lot so we can iterate before the call:

- KV cache consistency: for Dedicated pools in single-region deployments we maintain a local KV cache with async replication to warm nodes in a secondary region; strong cross-region consistency requires the customer to provision cross-region pins — I’ll prepare a slide showing trade-offs (latency vs consistency).
- 99th pct latency (512 tokens): with a 4-GPU Dedicated p4d pool and current perf profile we see ~450–700 ms for most models; 99th can spike toward 1.2s under bursty load without autoscaling. Will provide recent perf run numbers.
- Customer KMS/HSM: we support BYOK via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and have HSM connectors for private deployments; key rotation cadence is configurable — we recommend 90-day rotation.

I’m attaching a quick network sketch and will convert to a diagram for the agenda doc.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
